responsibility: Contains the main rs6000 machine-description patterns for AltiVec and later vector instruction support. It defines backend UNSPEC codes, mode iterators, vector move and arithmetic/permute/pack/unpack/compare patterns, expansions, and peepholes that lower GCC RTL and builtins into concrete PowerPC vector instructions, making it the central code-generation file for classic Altivec integer and floating-point vector operations.
same_name_distinction: This is the backend AltiVec machine-description file, defining UNSPEC codes, mode iterators, and RTL patterns for vector instructions. Unlike altivec.h, it is not a user include header and does not expose the intrinsic API macros directly.
